name: Hornero Dev Pulse
description: Dev Pulse: GitHub development activity through your existing gh sign-in - contributions, pull requests, reviews, an actionable inbox, and an optional side-by-side with Agent Deck AI usage. Local-first; unknown metrics stay unknown.
author: HorneroOS contributors

statsWindow.description: Activity window for Dev Pulse statistics.

repoFilter.description: Optional repository filter as owner/name (empty = all).

reactionsEnabled.description: Allow governed companion reactions for failing checks and review requests.

changelog.notes: Validate https:// URLs before invoking xdg-open and declare api.github.com in networkHosts.
Fix the activity-window selector: the data layer id `data` was shadowed by Item.data inside delegates, so no window could be selected or changed; also fixes a Bar label parse error.

Dev Pulse 1.0: bar indicator, quick popover, full Dev Pulse dashboard tab, development inbox, contribution analytics and optional Agent Deck comparison, all through horneroctl github (gh owns authentication; no token is ever requested or stored).
